findings.location: Lighthouse.Frontend/src/pages/Common/Reports/panels/ArrivalsPanel.test.tsx: it("reads a gap that rounds to nothing as many started as finished per day, and rounds before it compares") and it("reads Not captured for this report on both sides and puts Arrivals in no header group when the report never froze it")
findings.obligation: Oracle row: old report reads Not captured for this report; the print document shows the same words; 0.004 reads as many started as finished, 0.006 reads 0.01 more; header lists Arrivals. The print document is pinned only by it.each(WHERE) on the first value test. These two tests call openingTheReport("on the report", ...) only, so the print document is not exercised for the not-captured look or the rounded-gap look. Falsifier row names the print panel.
findings.remediation: Parameterise the rounding test and the not-captured test over WHERE (on the report, in the print), as the value test already is. Add the header-group assertion to the print case where the print document carries a summary. Owner oracle is the acceptance designer.

findings.obligation: Design says ThenNowPanelFrame is reused unchanged and keeps every other panel byte-identical (guarded by reportPanelRegistry.parity.test). The diff drops gutterBottom from the shared title and wraps it in a Box with mb 0.5 for all panels.
findings.remediation: Keep the original title spacing when no info control is given, or record the header spacing change for every panel in the design and sketch. Owner implementation.

findings.location: Lighthouse.Frontend/src/pages/Common/Reports/panels/ArrivalsPanel.tsx: const PER_DAY_DECIMALS = 2; and const totalText = (total: number | null, workItems: string): string => { (total-line rule)
findings.obligation: Design: ArrivalsPanel reuses ThroughputPanel's PER_DAY_DECIMALS and total-line rule by import; totalText is exported for reuse. The diff redeclares both locally. Craftsmanship: one owner per rule and config.
findings.remediation: Import PER_DAY_DECIMALS from ThroughputPanel and export totalText from it, or record why the copy is a coincidental similarity. Non-blocking. Owner implementation.

findings.obligation: Craftsmanship semantic DRY: the finished-per-day average is also the Throughput capture's per-day figure. The design says both stored figures come from one reader and one window and never disagree. Equality is pinned by Throughput_inside_the_arrivals_capture_is_the_figure..., but the average formula now has two owners.
findings.remediation: Take the per-day average from the one owner the Throughput metric uses (for example a shared helper on WindowedReportMetric), so the rule has one definition. Non-blocking. Owner implementation.
